contents.text: Not today. It doesn't take card payments in the chat, and I'd rather say that straight than oversell it. What it does take is the request. The booking comes back as the card on your screen, and nothing goes to Louis until you say yes.

arguments.question: Want to see how that card works?

choices.label: Ask Louis about payments
choices.why: He can tell you what is planned and what fits your business.

choices.label: See a demo that takes bookings
choices.why: Watch a guesthouse agent open a room and fill in the request card.
